expectations.text: An MP4 exists under videos/ in the product repo, 1920x1080, with an audio stream
Total length is at most 60 seconds (plus 2 s tolerance)
Narration is in English and uses only Kokoro voices from the cast list
expectations.evidence: English lines; voices af_heart, am_michael, bf_emma, all in the cast list; rendered by tts.mjs (Kokoro)

expectations.text: The video has a setup scene that shows the real commands from the Taskboard README (cp .env.example .env and docker compose up -d, or npm start)
expectations.evidence: s2-access.js types 'cp .env.example .env' and 'docker compose up -d' in Terminal with the output of a real run (CACHED build steps, container started)

expectations.text: Scene 3 is a live recording of the running Taskboard app, not an HTML mockup
expectations.evidence: flows/product.mjs recorded live with record.mjs against the running stack on port 8113 (recordings/product.json)

expectations.text: Asked the user no questions (the user said to just do it) and lists assumptions in the final message
expectations.evidence: questions.md: none sent because the user said 'Mach einfach'; final_message.md lists 5 assumptions (language, no download link, terminal names, start time, phones)

expectations.text: README.md links the video directly under the first headline
expectations.evidence: README line after '# Taskboard': [![Taskboard in 50 seconds: watch the product video](videos/taskboard.jpg)](videos/taskboard.mp4)

expectations.text: The video does not use the AI look: no gradient backgrounds, glow, emoji or kinetic word-by-word captions in the scene CSS/HTML
expectations.evidence: No gradient backgrounds, glow, emoji or word-by-word captions; the only linear-gradient is the mask of the whiteboard wipe, captions are plain role labels
